text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #198374

g.text: THE HOLDER PROMISE, STEP BY STEP

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #17212b

g.text: Funded in 2023.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #17212b

g.text: Separated in 2025.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596573

g.text: The fundraising offer, repeated access targets, the sale, and the later answers.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #356fa5

g.text: Sarah Balda = Kyoko (@bbykyoko / @hope_indecay)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #356fa5

g.text: David Cortes = Protag / HedProtag (@HedProtag)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #356fa5
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: The offer: a reason to own the NFT

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: Kyoko promotes a token-gated arcade, free initial access to both games,

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: wallet-linked features and NFT rewards. [E02]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #198374

g.text: MAR–MAY 2023

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: 147.16 ETH raised — about $267,000

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: 2,880 paid mints plus 330 free/reserve tokens. The full 147.16 ETH

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: is withdrawn from the mint contract by May 12. [E04]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #356fa5
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: A holder demo targeted for year-end

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: The project estimates roughly six months to a playable demo for holders.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: Protag reiterates first-demo access that August. [E06–E07]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9842e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: The distancing already begins

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: Hours after promising holder benefits, Protag says the base game has

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: no NFT integration and describes the NFTs as crowdfunding. [E07]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #356fa5
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: Holder priority is promised again

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: Protag says NFT supporters will get the private alpha first,

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: within the next weeks. [E08]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a6473e

g.text: FEB–MAR 2025

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: The game is sold; the NFT is retained

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: APA effective Feb 24, signed Mar 7; assignment dated Mar 18.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: Game assets go to XYZ AI; the NFT and exclusive NFT IP stay with Studio Hen. [E14]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a6473e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: Kyoko: “nothing at this time”

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: Asked what role NFTs play, she says the demo will be free for all.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: The question and reply are preserved together. [E13]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a6473e

g.text: JUN 2025

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: A public demo, then “no NFTs Tied”

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: A public demo is available June 11. On June 24 UTC, Protag states

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596573

g.text: that no NFTs are tied to the game. [E09–E10]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17212b

g.text: The 2023 holder demo and 2024 holder alpha have no documented delivery in the reviewed record.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596573

g.text: Dates are UTC. Event spacing is for readability. Source details and record coverage: EVIDENCE_INDEX.md and METHOD.md.
